response.query: Which microstructure-noise correction methods (realized-kernel, subsampling, pre-averaging) and thin-trading adjustments will be pre-specified for each market and frequency?
response.answer: Realized-kernel, subsampling, and pre-averaging methods, along with thin-trading adjustments, will be pre-specified for each market and frequency based on empirical performance and specific market conditions. These methods aim to correct microstructure noise and improve volatility estimation.
